sloka: कथयामास धर्मात्मा तस्य शब्दस्य निश्चयम् ।कैलास पर्वते राम मनसा निर्मितम् परम् ॥१-२४-८॥
transliteration: kathayāmāsa dharmātmā tasya śabdasya niścayam ।kailāsa parvate rāma manasā nirmitam param ॥1-24-8॥

translations.english: "O tiger among men, Rama. Brahma created out of his mind a lake on mount Kailas and so that lake is called Manasa (Sarovara).
